modules.module_title: Conduct assessment as per preset standards

pcs.pc_description: reach the venue at appropriate date, time with relevant materials, questionnaires, tools, recorders etc.
communicate the purpose, requirements and processes of assessment of vocational skills, knowledge and understanding to learners
instruct the candidates at the start of the assessment regarding duration of the assessment, rules to be followed, entire process and penalties for breaking of the rules
mark attendance as per the standard practice
gather required documents from learners
use technology while conducting assessment activities such as video evidence of skills/performance, recording of oral evidence, computer-based/on-line testing; etc.
check and authenticate the video recordings and other evidences to see if there are no shortcomings, else retake the recording and evidences
follow procedures for the confidentiality of assessment information
interpret assessment standards/criteria correctly
examine evidence against assessment standards/criteria
ensure that assessment decision is consistent and based on the available evidence and rules of evidence
document the results on paper templates as well as online forms and templates as prescribed accurately
complete candidate records accurately and submit or process in the required time frame
secure, label and pack the evidences accurately as per standard procedures adopted by an assessment body
monitor the cleanliness and tidiness of the assessment area
notify any special housekeeping requirements, maintenance requirements or training equipment repair requirements to appropriate personnel
secure the equipment and tools used during assessment while ensuring that they are in good condition
